decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8649. Series context: trend strength 0.6294 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.135); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 5.741.
